dslRule:
<!id: stream-tostring-to-joining>
<!description: Replace Stream.toString() with a Collector.joining() for useful debugging output, as Stream.toString() does not represent elements.
Consider adjusting the delimiter and mapper function for specific contexts, but Object::toString is a safe default.>
<!severity: HINT>
$collection.stream().toString() :: instanceof($collection, "java.util.Collection")
=> $collection.stream().map(java.lang.Object::toString).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.joining(", "))
;;
